title: VA Integrated Medication Manager
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to advance the science of healthcare informatics and to improve medication management through the development of a new approach to the electronic medical record called the Integrated Medication Manager (IMM).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Practiced in primary care for at least two years
* Third year residents with two years of residency in internal medicine or family practice
* Do not have to be currently practicing

Exclusion Criteria:

* None
